scope: Proposition 4.1 (Taylor transport of background moments) of the manuscript “Logarithmic Relative Fluctuations in the Weakly Disordered Planar Ising Model” (preprints/Logarithmic-Relative-Fluctuations-in-the-Weakly-Disordered-Planar-Ising-Model-October-5-2026/critical-relative-second-moment-weak-random-bond-ising.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ec0e1bb240b41be6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under (4.1), the mean and the raw moment and cumulant arrays with at most four arguments are given by the ordinary zero- background Taylor rule, retaining total background degree at most four, with error O(s5) in the prescribed weighted indexed projective norms. The coefficient maps are bounded uniformly in the scale. An output cumulant vanishes if its dependence carriers split into two nonempty mutually separated families.
